cards.mood: The piece opens with a desolate, haunting atmosphere that feels suspended in time, characterized by sparse instrumentation and an intimate vocal delivery.
cards.palette: A clean, finger-picked electric guitar establishes the harmonic foundation in the verses, switching to a heavily distorted, overdriven tone with power-chord rhythms for the choruses.

[Intro]
[Verse]
Salt hangs heavy in the frozen air
Waves carve secrets in the grey and deep
I watch the ghost of the moon appear
